title: Sabotage/Quotes
kind: 場所・ミッション・その他

lines: - Lotus: "The Grineer have been harvesting a nearby planetoid for weapons-grade material. Locate and destroy their mining equipment."
- Lotus: "The mining equipment is nearby. It must be destroyed to prevent the Grineer from developing energy weapons."
- Lotus: "This research could have unimaginable repercussions. Be on your guard."
- Lotus: "Mission success hinges on the destruction of the mining equipment. Expect heavy resistance."
- Lotus: "Excellent work. You have managed to thwart potentially dangerous discoveries from being fully realized, for now."
- Lotus: "The Grineer are preparing to magnetically mine asteroids for rare alloys to be used in body augmentations and modifications. Paralyze their research by destroying the mining equipment."
- Lotus: "A heavily armed security force stands between you and the mining equipment. Stay alert."
- Lotus: "Crippling their equipment will effectively cripple their research."
- Lotus: "We need you back alive. Stay alert."
- Lotus: "You are gaining the upper hand. Push forward."
- Lotus: "They are aware of your presence. Make haste."
- Lotus: "Well done. You have brought the Grineer research to a sudden halt."

- Lotus: "A dormant comet is being targeted by the Grineer for its volatile materials. The material will be used in the manufacturing of fuel propellant for their fleet. Locate and cripple their equipment."
- Lotus: "Destroy the mining equipment before the Grineer can intercept the comet."
- Lotus: "It is time to bring the Grineer fleet to a standstill. Strike them where it hurts."
- Lotus: "Halting fuel production will give us a much needed advantage. Determine the position of the equipment."
- Lotus: "Hostiles inbound. Strike hard and fast."
- Lotus: "Impressive. This will temporarily immobilize the Grineer fleet. We will move-in and claim the comet."
- Lotus: "The Grineer have set their sights on a large asteroid thought to contain an abundance of Rubedo. Locate and destroy the extraction equipment."
- Lotus: "Rubedo must be protected at any cost. Sabotage the nearby mining equipment."
- Lotus: "It is imperative we do not let the Grineer get their hands on the Rubedo."
- Lotus: "You are approaching a piece of equipment. Watch your back."
- Lotus: "Good work. Your efforts have prevented Grineer access to the Rubedo. We have an extraction team en route to appropriate the planetoid's contents."
- Lotus: "I need you to sabotage this ship's reactor."
- Lotus: "The reactor is a complex system. Start by removing the coolant cells."
- Lotus: "Security has locked down the coolant cells. We have no choice but to destroy them."
- Lotus: "Security measures have locked the coolant cells in place. Destroy them."
- Lotus: "A coolant cell has been extracted."
- Lotus: "The reactor is going into stasis. Now is your chance to complete this sabotage. Use whatever you can to make sure it doesn't work again."
- Lotus: "Hack the console to restart the reactor."
- Lotus: "The reactor must be restarted to trigger your sabotage."
- Lotus: "Fuel cell reinserted. When the reactor is restarted, this will trigger meltdown."
- Lotus: "The reactor has gone critical. Get to extraction immediately."
- Lotus: "A blast door has blocked your evacuation route. Find a way to open it."
- Lotus: "A coolant cell has been placed in the fuel port."
- Lotus: "Defend the system until the coolant has flooded the fuel system."
- Lotus: "The enemy has destroyed a reactor pipe. You must protect them."
- Lotus: "Watch your step Tenno. There are severe coolant leaks throughout the ship."
- Lotus: "All the pipes have been destroyed. The enemy has prevented the reactor from destroying itself. This mission is a failure."
- Lotus: "A fuel cell has been placed in the coolant system. Restarting the reactor will produce hazardous magnetic activity."
- Lotus: "Guard the console and prevent lockdowns while the fuel erodes the coolant system."
- Lotus: "A security lockdown has stalled your progress. Clear it."
- Lotus: "Beware Tenno. The ship is experiencing reduced gravity and magnetic anomalies."
- Lotus: "Your sabotage is complete, get to extraction."
- Lotus: "You're here to sabotage Tyl Regor's cloning labs."
- Lotus: "This lab is the birthplace of some the most dangerous Grineer to date. Knock it out of commission."
- Lotus: "You are nearing one of Tyl Regor's newest creations. Make sure it never sees the surface."
- Lotus: "Good work. That beast won't be able to threaten any Tenno in the field."
- Lotus: "The beast is dead. Your work is done."
- Lotus: "Find a way to sabotage this lab."
- Lotus: "Make sure this lab never clones again."
- Lotus: "This lab is out of commission."
- Lotus: "Good work. The lab is useless now."
- Lotus: "There is no telling what effect destroying these hives will have. Stay alert."
- Lotus: "I'm detecting fewer and fewer infected ships. Your tireless onslaught is working. Keep fighting."
- Lotus: "This infestation must be contained. Destroy the hives to sterilize the area."
- Lotus: "We must not let this infestation get any more out of control. Destroy the spawning hives in the area."
- Lotus: "You are near a hive. Destroy the tumor nodes to make the hive vulnerable."
- Lotus: "A hive is nearby. Be on alert, there's no way to know how the infestation will react to this hive's destruction."
- Lotus: "There is a hive in the area. You must destroy all tumor nodes before you can damage the hive."
- Lotus: "You are approaching a hive. Every hive is protected by a series of tumor nodes, destroy those and you can destroy the hive."
- Lotus: "All nodes destroyed, the hive is vulnerable."
- Lotus: "That's it, now take out the hive."
- Lotus: "Taking out that hive has disrupted the environmental system. Expect sub zero temperatures and weakened shields."
- Lotus: "Watch out! Destroying that hive released clouds of toxins."
- Lotus: "Destroying that hive damaged the stabilization module. Expect reduced gravity."
- Lotus: "Killing that hive seems to have triggered nearby laser traps. Proceed with caution."
- Lotus: "Hive destroyed, but be careful, I am now detecting fields of intense magnetic disturbance."
- Lotus: "That last hive was interfering with the defense systems. Beware, turrets are now online."
- Lotus: "All hives destroyed. Head to extraction."

- Ordis: "Elemental condensers? Helium-3 processors? Alad's facility is consuming Jupiter's resources on a massive scale! Operator, you certainly have an eye for strategic targets. Ordis has marked key infrastructure for demolition. Get in there and - kick - access the facility."
- Ordis: "First targets marked, render them non-functional."
- Ordis: "Most efficient Operator. Ordis has located the next bank of machinery."
- Ordis: "These elemental condensers are the heart of Alad's operation, his profit center. Smash it up!"
- Ordis: "Helium-3 processors are key to the operation of this facility's reactor cores. It would be a shame if something happened to them."
- Ordis: "Now, turn your attention to the reactor core. Locate the console and initiate the overdrive sequence."
- Ordis: "Overdrive sequence in progress. This will take a few moments. Do not allow Alad's personnel to reverse the sequence."
- Ordis: "Success! Core melt initiated. In a few brief moments, this facility will cease to exist. May Ordis suggest running for your life?"
